method.structure: Unchanged 117-parameter shade/vintage contextual tare curve shared across provenances; same hard training tare-tie constraints and weak monotonicity
method.validation: Five repeated outer 5-family/inner 3-family folds. Identical outer test rows for new fold-trained v6-evidence control and v7-evidence candidate. Only training labels fix steps and select hyperparameters.
method.limits: Exploratory adaptive evidence; no pristine holdout. Shared curves can force confirmed strict preferences to zero when another provenance ties; conflicts explicitly audited, not removed. No promotion.
